name: typesafe-jev
description: Design guidance for Jev, TypeSafe's typed-judgment model: task fit, question shape, batching, composition, thresholds, and failure handling.

interface.shortDescription: Design Jev calls that hold up in production
interface.longDescription: A design walk-through for features that call Jev: decide whether the task is Jev-shaped, word narrow questions, lay out state and fan out calls, compose Jev with code, LLMs and people, calibrate thresholds on held-out data, and choose fail-open or fail-closed behaviour. Backed by an evidence table of 38 hack day projects and 16 reusable patterns.
